headline.family_guess: serif (Georgia/Tiempos-like) for statement lines; grotesk sans for labels/UI
headline.weight: regular-medium, occasional italic for emphasis word
headline.size_rel: large, ~2-4 words per screen, center or left aligned

caption.family_guess: small grotesk sans, all-lowercase in UI chips
caption.case: lowercase for chip labels, sentence case for VO-sync text

layout.safe_zones: generous top/bottom margin (~8-10%), content vertically centered, no bottom-third clutter
layout.caption_pos: VO-sync text appears center-screen as standalone typographic beats, not burned subtitles at bottom

motion.cut_rate_per_10s: ~10 cuts/10s (near 1 cut per second, matches contact-sheet sampling)
transitions: word-by-word text build (VO drives one word/phrase per screen)
icon morph (robot mascot appears/disappears, funnel shape recolors)
motion blur whip on repeated-object cut (t=41-42s)
